headings: What’s in a Name: The Impact of Domain Names on Honeypot Effectiveness

metadata.name: description
metadata.content: Research honeypots are a foundational tool for collecting cyber threat intelligence and detecting novel threats. However, the practical question of how to make a honeypot look sufficiently realistic remains underexplored. This study examines the impact of one measurable realism cue: the presence of a realistic domain name.
